title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Woodstock Corp’s 7th Largest Position
text:
Woodstock Corp cut its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.3% in the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 63,982 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 865 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 2.2% of Woodstock Corp’s holdings, making the stock its 7th biggest holding. Woodstock Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $11,844,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
A number of other institutional investors have also recently bought and sold shares of the business. Kiley Juergens Wealth Management LLC raised its position in Apple by 1.0% in the second quarter. Kiley Juergens Wealth Management LLC now owns 39,001 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $7,219,000 after purchasing an additional 381 shares during the last quarter. Sumitomo Life Insurance Co. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 0.8% in the second quarter. Sumitomo Life Insurance Co. now owns 171,892 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $31,819,000 after buying an additional 1,356 shares during the period. Biechele Royce Advisors increased its stake in shares of Apple by 2.3% in the second quarter. Biechele Royce Advisors now owns 46,878 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $8,678,000 after buying an additional 1,046 shares during the period. Rossmore Private Capital increased its stake in shares of Apple by 74.8% in the second quarter. Rossmore Private Capital now owns 22,243 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,117,000 after buying an additional 9,515 shares during the period. Finally, Beese Fulmer Investment Management Inc. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 2.6% in the second quarter. Beese Fulmer Investment Management Inc. now owns 68,042 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $12,595,000 after buying an additional 1,694 shares during the period. In other news, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 25,000 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, October 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $232.66, for a total value of $5,816,500.00. Following the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares in the company, valued at $24,554,471.08. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, insider Johny Srouji sold 14,140 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, August 17th. The shares were sold at an average price of $214.98, for a total value of $3,039,817.20. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 68,302 shares in the company, valued at approximately $14,683,563.96. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 564,185 shares of company stock valued at $124,444,213 in the last three months. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
Shares of Apple stock opened at $222.73 on Wednesday. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $150.24 and a 52 week high of $233.47. The company has a market capitalization of $1,084.53 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.18, a PEG ratio of 1.69 and a beta of 1.36.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $1.67 earnings per share. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. As a group, research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 EPS for the current year.
Several brokerages have recently weighed in on AAPL. Loop Capital increased their price target on Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, July 6th. BidaskClub cut Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, September 12th. Morgan Stanley reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $247.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, October 10th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $240.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, September 11th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have given a hold rating and thirty-one have issued a buy rating to the company. The stock currently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $224.63.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
